dispositions.rationale: On the integration-repair path a proven main-only candidate moves to ready and merges without finalize or archive: _require_finalized only refuses still-active completed changes, and the in-repo receipt checks (archive_content_problems, require_automated_evidence) run only for active-change archive readiness, developer handoff and composition, never for an archived ready candidate. A later finalize or handoff follows a content change that needs fresh evidence anyway. The in-repo receipt cannot carry the trusted old head the proof requires, so rebinding it would trust candidate files.
